questions.question: Which of the following is a correct description of asthma?
options: A highly infectious disease spread by water droplets
A common non-infectious disease that can cause breathing difficulties
A genetic disease that only affects the liver and kidneys
An infectious bacterial disease of the digestive system

questions.question: What happens to the bronchial tubes (breathing tubes) during an asthma attack?
options: They widen significantly to allow more air in
They narrow, making it harder to breathe

questions.question: Which pair of symptoms is commonly associated with an asthma attack?
Which of the following is identified as a risk factor for developing asthma?
options: A diet high in vitamin C

questions.question: Which statement correctly describes how infectious diseases behave?
options: They can only be inherited from parents
They can be passed from one organism to another
They are exclusively caused by poor dietary choices
They cannot be transmitted under any circumstances

questions.question: Infectious diseases are caused by pathogens. Which of these are examples of pathogens?
What is a key characteristic of non-infectious diseases?
options: They are highly contagious and spread through the air
They cannot be passed from one organism to another
They are always cured using standard antibiotics
They are only found in plants, not humans

questions.question: How do eating an unbalanced diet and not getting enough exercise affect human health?
options: They directly cause infectious diseases to spread faster
They can increase the risk of developing lifestyle diseases
They guarantee immunity to respiratory infections
They have no impact on long-term physical health

questions.question: What name is given to the group of drugs that people take specifically when they are ill?
What are the two main classes used to group recreational drugs based on their effects on the nervous system?
How do depressant drugs affect the body's functioning?
options: They speed up physical movement and increase alertness
They slow down thinking and reaction times
They cure bacterial infections within the respiratory system
They improve memory retention and muscle strength

questions.question: What is a typical effect of a stimulant drug on a person's body?
options: It makes them feel sleepy and reduces their heart rate
It slows down their reaction times
It makes them feel more alert and can give them quicker reaction times
It acts as a painkiller to numb physical sensations

questions.question: Which chemical found in tobacco leaves is highly addictive and affects the body?
What is the term used for inhaling chemicals, such as those in glue or paint thinner, to become intoxicated?
What is a major risk associated with solvent abuse?
options: Long-term health problems and potential death

questions.question: Which substance is consumed during both smoking and vaping, posing a detriment to health?
Which statement best describes what we currently know about the health effects of vaping?
options: They are fully known and proven to be completely harmless
They are not yet fully known
They are identical in every way to smoking tobacco
They only affect the digestive system
